title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1988-09-02
lineage: Nakamichi CR7A>Lucid AD9624>Fostex D5>DAT> Tascam DA20MKII>Tascam CDRW700>CDR> Wavelab 6>CDWave>Flac Frontend(Level 6); Recording by DATBRAD; Master cassette transfer to DAT by Mark Lynn*; DAT to CDR and conversion to wav>flac by DATBRAD
source: OTS 2 Nakamichi CM100s w/10v batt/cP4 shotguns(XY)>Sony TCD5M (Maxell MX90s);

ai_review.summary: Excellent clean copy with a flawless Althea intro and no tape‑flip hiccup.
ai_review.review: The reviewer crowns this version the go‑to take because it eliminates the notorious tape‑flip glitch at the start of “Althea,” delivering a pristine opening. While no musical commentary is offered, the spotless recording makes it highly recommendable for listeners seeking an uninterrupted performance.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review enthusiastically praises the tape‑flip‑free recording; no musical critique is provided, so rating leans heavily on recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No tape‑flip or hiccup at the beginning of Althea; clean and uninterrupted intro.
